check_box.label: Depth of field
check_box.tool_tip: Blur the scene away from the focus distance, like a camera lens. Toggling causes a brief hitch.
check_box.name: dof_enable

slider.label: F-number
slider.name: dof_fnumber
slider.tool_tip: Aperture f-number. Lower values give a shallower focus plane and stronger blur.

slider.label: Focal length (mm)
slider.name: dof_focal_length
slider.tool_tip: Lens focal length in millimeters. Longer lenses compress and blur backgrounds more.

check_box.label: Lock focus point
check_box.tool_tip: Freeze the current focus distance in place (not saved between sessions)
check_box.name: dof_focus_locked

check_box.label: Focus follows pointer
check_box.tool_tip: Continuously refocus on whatever is under the mouse pointer (not saved between sessions)
check_box.name: dof_focus_pointer

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_dof_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Field of view
slider.name: dof_fov
slider.tool_tip: Vertical field of view (degrees) the DoF model assumes for the virtual camera

slider.label: Max blur (CoC)
slider.name: dof_max_cof
slider.tool_tip: Maximum circle-of-confusion size, capping how strong the blur can get

slider.label: Resolution scale
slider.name: dof_res_scale
slider.tool_tip: Resolution the blur is computed at. 1 = full resolution (sharpest, slowest); 0.25 = quarter.

slider.label: Focus transition (s)
slider.name: dof_transition
slider.tool_tip: Seconds the camera takes to rack focus between distances

check_box.label: Blur foreground (near blur)
check_box.tool_tip: Also blur objects closer than the focus distance
check_box.name: dof_near_blur

check_box.label: Keep DoF while editing
check_box.tool_tip: Leave depth of field active while build/edit tools are open
check_box.name: dof_edit_mode

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_dof_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced depth of field settings to defaults

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: bloom_strength
slider.tool_tip: How strongly the bloom is blended into the scene

slider.label: Threshold
slider.name: bloom_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Luminance (linear light) above which pixels bloom; 1.0 is roughly brighter-than-white

slider.label: Scatter
slider.name: bloom_scatter
slider.tool_tip: Bloom spread per octave. Above about 2.5 the filter starts to alias.

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_bloom_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Knee
slider.name: bloom_knee
slider.tool_tip: Soft-knee width below the threshold; wider gives a more gradual bloom onset

slider.label: Prim glow boost
slider.name: bloom_alpha_boost
slider.tool_tip: Multiplier for legacy prim-glow when fed into HDR bloom, so glowing objects match legacy brightness

slider.label: Mip count
slider.name: bloom_mips
slider.tool_tip: Bloom pyramid levels; more mips = wider, softer bloom. Changing causes a brief hitch.

combo_box.name: bloom_res_scale_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Resolution the bloom pyramid starts at. Lower resolutions are faster and reach wider per mip. Changing causes a brief hitch.

check_box.label: Halation
check_box.tool_tip: Enable the warm halo signal around bright highlights (uses a wider pyramid format). Toggling causes a brief hitch.
check_box.name: bloom_halation

slider.label: Halation strength
slider.name: bloom_halation_strength
slider.tool_tip: Photographic halation amount; 0.25 is a gentle cinematic feel

color_swatch.name: bloom_halation_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: Color of the halation halo; default is warm amber

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_bloom_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced bloom settings to defaults

panel.name: sec_glow
panel.text: Applies when HDR rendering is off.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: glow_strength
slider.tool_tip: Additive strength of the glow

slider.label: Width
slider.name: glow_width
slider.tool_tip: Glow sample size; wider is softer but eventually pixelated

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_glow_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Iterations
slider.name: glow_iterations
slider.tool_tip: Blur passes; higher is wider and smoother but slower

slider.label: Max extract alpha
slider.name: glow_max_alpha
slider.tool_tip: Cap on brightness-extracted auto-glow

slider.label: Min luminance
slider.name: glow_min_lum
slider.tool_tip: Minimum luminance for an object to auto-glow; 9999 effectively disables auto-glow

slider.label: Resolution (pow 2)
slider.name: glow_res_pow
slider.tool_tip: Glow map resolution as a power of two (9 = 512)

check_box.label: HDR glow map
check_box.tool_tip: Use an HDR format for the glow map
check_box.name: glow_hdr

slider.label: Warmth amount
slider.name: glow_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Blend between luminance extraction (0) and warmth extraction (1)

text.name: glow_lum_weights_label
text.tool_tip: Per-channel weights for luminance extraction (should sum to 1)

text.name: glow_warmth_weights_label
text.tool_tip: Per-channel weights used before taking the max warmth

check_box.label: Glow noise (dither)
check_box.tool_tip: Dither the glow to reduce banding
check_box.name: glow_noise

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_glow_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced glow settings to defaults

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: flare_strength
slider.tool_tip: Master lens flare intensity; 0 turns the effect off entirely

color_swatch.name: flare_streak_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: Color of the anamorphic streak; the default cool blue mimics coated cinema lenses

slider.label: Glow
slider.name: flare_glow
slider.tool_tip: Intensity of the soft central glow around the sun

slider.label: Starburst
slider.name: flare_starburst
slider.tool_tip: Intensity of the diffraction-spike starburst radiating from the sun

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_flare_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Length
slider.name: flare_streak_length
slider.tool_tip: How far the anamorphic streak stretches; 1.0 crosses the full screen width

slider.label: Falloff
slider.name: flare_streak_falloff
slider.tool_tip: How quickly the streak fades toward its tips; lower leaves a longer tail

slider.label: Thickness
slider.name: flare_streak_thickness
slider.tool_tip: Vertical thickness of the streak; low is a hairline, high a soft band

slider.label: Intensity
slider.name: flare_streak_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of just the streak, separate from the master strength

slider.label: Chromatic spread
slider.name: flare_chromatic_spread
slider.tool_tip: Red/blue separation along the streak; 1 gives a strong rainbow split

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: flare_glow_radius
slider.tool_tip: Size of the soft glow around the sun

slider.label: Falloff
slider.name: flare_glow_falloff
slider.tool_tip: Softness of the central glow; lower spreads it out, higher keeps it tight

slider.label: Intensity
slider.name: flare_ghost
slider.tool_tip: Intensity of the lens ghost circles; 0 disables ghosts

slider.label: Count
slider.name: flare_ghost_count
slider.tool_tip: Number of ghost circles along the sun-to-center line

slider.label: Spacing
slider.name: flare_ghost_spacing
slider.tool_tip: Distance between consecutive ghosts

slider.label: Intensity
slider.name: flare_halo
slider.tool_tip: Intensity of the halo ring opposite the sun; 0 disables the halo

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: flare_halo_radius
slider.tool_tip: Radius of the halo ring

slider.label: Width
slider.name: flare_halo_width
slider.tool_tip: Thickness of the halo ring; small is a crisp hoop, large a diffuse ring

slider.label: Spikes
slider.name: flare_starburst_spikes
slider.tool_tip: Number of aperture-like spikes; real lenses show twice the blade count

slider.label: Sharpness
slider.name: flare_starburst_sharpness
slider.tool_tip: Low values give soft wide rays; high values give thin needle-like beams

slider.label: Length
slider.name: flare_starburst_length
slider.tool_tip: Length of the starburst spikes

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: flare_occlusion_radius
slider.tool_tip: Width of the sun-occlusion depth test; larger lets thin geometry dim the flare gracefully

slider.label: Samples
slider.name: flare_occlusion_taps
slider.tool_tip: Depth samples for occlusion testing; more gives smoother transitions at slight cost

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_flare_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced lens flare settings to defaults

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: ca_strength
slider.tool_tip: Color fringe intensity. 0 disables; 0.15 is a subtle cinema lens feel.

slider.label: Falloff
slider.name: ca_falloff
slider.tool_tip: How quickly fringing grows from center to edge; higher keeps the center clean

slider.label: Angle
slider.name: ca_angle
slider.tool_tip: Rotates the red/blue split direction (degrees); only matters when anisotropy is nonzero

slider.label: Anisotropy
slider.name: ca_anisotropy
slider.tool_tip: Stretches the fringe along the angle axis for an anamorphic-style directional smear

slider.label: Red offset X
slider.name: ca_offset_rx
slider.tool_tip: Red channel horizontal shift direction

slider.label: Red offset Y
slider.name: ca_offset_ry
slider.tool_tip: Red channel vertical shift direction

slider.label: Blue offset X
slider.name: ca_offset_bx
slider.tool_tip: Blue channel horizontal shift direction; typically opposite the red offset

slider.label: Blue offset Y
slider.name: ca_offset_by
slider.tool_tip: Blue channel vertical shift direction

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: vignette_amount
slider.tool_tip: Opacity of the vignette; 0 disables

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: vignette_radius
slider.tool_tip: Vignette size in image-height units; 1.0 reaches the top and bottom edges

slider.label: Feather
slider.name: vignette_feather
slider.tool_tip: Shape of the darkening curve: below 1 spreads a gentle haze inward, above 1 concentrates darkening at the corners

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_vignette_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: Softness
slider.name: vignette_soft
slider.tool_tip: Softness of the vignette edge

slider.label: Shape
slider.name: vignette_shape
slider.tool_tip: 0 is circular, 1 is a rounded square

slider.label: Mid point
slider.name: vignette_midpoint
slider.tool_tip: Position of the middle color in the three-color ramp; 0 disables (two-color vignette)

color_swatch.name: vignette_midcolor
color_swatch.tool_tip: Intermediate ramp color, used when mid point is above 0

text.name: vignette_center_label
text.tool_tip: Offset of the vignette center (X and Y; the third value is unused)

check_box.label: Correct for aspect ratio
check_box.tool_tip: Keep the vignette circular on wide screens instead of stretching with the frame
check_box.name: vignette_aspect

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_vignette_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced vignette settings to defaults

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: grain_amount
slider.tool_tip: Film grain strength; 0 disables

slider.label: Size
slider.name: grain_size
slider.tool_tip: Size of the grain particles

combo_box.name: grain_style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Grain character: mono luma, color (digital push), coarse (16mm feel), or photon shot (CCD sensor)

slider.label: Luma range
slider.name: grain_range
slider.tool_tip: Luma position where grain peaks: 0 shadows only, 0.5 midtones (classic film), 1 highlights only

color_swatch.name: grain_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: Grain color; white is neutral, warm tints suggest film, cool tints suggest video noise

check_box.label: Animated
check_box.tool_tip: Re-randomize the grain every frame, like real film
check_box.name: grain_animated

slider.label: Sharpness (CAS)
slider.name: sharp_cas
slider.tool_tip: Contrast Adaptive Sharpening strength
